definitions.explanation: Restricting or confining something to a certain scope, number, or condition. Often used to describe limited-edition products or exclusive access.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}とする。
examples.english: It will be limited to members only.

examples.japanese: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}の{商品|しょうひん}はすぐに{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The limited-quantity products sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: この{割引|わりびき}は{今月|こんげつ}{限定|げんてい}なので、{早|はや}めに{申|もう}し{込|こ}んでください。
examples.english: This discount is limited to this month, so please sign up early.

notes:
{限定|げんてい} means to limit or restrict something to a specified scope or quantity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限定|げんてい}する (to limit, to restrict)
- {限定|げんてい}{品|ひん} (limited-edition item)
- {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい} (limited time)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい} (limited quantity)
- {地域|ちいき}{限定|げんてい} (region-exclusive)
- {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい} (members only)

As a modifier, {限定|げんてい} is often placed directly before a noun: {限定|げんてい}{販売|はんばい} (limited sale).
